title: Group highlights
subtitle: AI updates, news and stories from your groups. Read each event once, return when it develops.
nodeOnly: Group highlights are available in Desktop and CLI Web.
autoOn: Updates every three hours while running
backlog: {count} messages waiting; update again to continue
startTitle: Keep the signal from your groups
startHint: Choose groups, save, then update. The first run covers the last 30 days; later runs only analyze new messages.
firstRun: Analyzing recent messages. Highlights will appear as batches finish.
empty: No highlights match this view. Update, change the time window or choose another category.
evidenceHint: Group discussions and shared links have not been independently verified.
settingsHint: Reads groups already imported into ChatLab. Each run allows up to 12 model calls; continue backlog in later runs. Source messages are preserved.
interestsHint: For example: AI coding, agents, new models, useful tools
enableAuto: Analyze every three hours while the app is running
curatedHint: {count} highlights, prioritizing tools, solutions and clear conclusions
allHint: {count} topics, ordered by value and preferences; unanswered questions come last
renewedHint: At least three independent discussions in the past 24 hours; this does not imply a new conclusion.
feedbackHint: Lower priority affects highlights while retaining valuable content. Click to restore, then save.
rebuildHint: Reanalyze the past 30 days with current rules, using model tokens. Retire old topics no longer selected after completion; keep bookmarks and read state.
costEstimateHint: Costs use your configured prices, including summaries and search, and may differ from provider bills. Unpriced and uncertain calls are shown separately.
nearBudget: Estimated monthly usage has reached 80% of your budget.
unpricedUsage: {count} unpriced calls; {uncertain} uncertain calls. Calls from earlier versions are outside this ledger.
reconcileHint: After checking your bill, enter the combined cost of this month’s unpriced, uncertain and other-currency calls in the current currency:
searchTopicsHint: For example: the CPA dashboard someone shared, and any later conclusions
searchCoverage: Matched intent against {count} retained topics, independent of the current time filter. Search may use model tokens.
digestStale: Topics have changed. This is the previous summary; refresh it for the latest view.
digestCoverage: Synthesized from up to 80 ranked non-question topics in this period. Group reports are not externally verified.
digestHint: Summaries use existing topics after analysis. You can also generate one manually; model usage is recorded.
groupRecommendations: Group quality within your selected scope
recommendationsHint: Based on useful tools, solutions, noise and repeated sources in analyzed content. Message volume is not a quality rank; scope stays under your control.
recommendationEvidence: {analyzed} messages analyzed; {useful} tools/solutions among {topics} topics; {noise} identified noise messages and {repeats} additional sources.
budgetHint: Blank means no money limit; 0 pauses calls. Estimated cost is reserved before requests. With a limit, missing prices or unknown charges pause model calls. Actual bills can differ.
pricedModel: Prices apply to this fast model
knowledgeReviewHint: Review the problem, conditions, outcome and sources. Approval writes to ChatLab inside your configured vault without overwriting existing notes.
configureVaultFirst: Set your vault path in group preferences first.

budgetPaused.limit: The estimated budget is exhausted or insufficient for another reservation. Model calls are paused.
budgetPaused.pricing: Current model prices are missing. Calls pause under a money limit until prices are configured.
budgetPaused.uncertain: This month has unpriced, uncertain or other-currency costs. Reconcile them against your bill before resuming budgeted calls.

partialCost: Priced portion only; {count} unpriced / {uncertain} uncertain calls
